text:
Which effect is not due to thermal expansion?
A
convection currents in air
B
expansion of a bubble rising through a fizzy drink
C
expansion of a liquid in a thermometer
D
lengthening of overhead power lines in the summer

options.label: B
options.text: expansion of a bubble rising through a fizzy drink

options.label: C
options.text: expansion of a liquid in a thermometer

options.label: D
options.text: lengthening of overhead power lines in the summer
